source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    templates = []
    template_cells = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if row[c] == 0:
                c += 1
                continue
            start = c
            while c < w and row[c] != 0:
                c += 1
            if c - start > 1:
                seq = row[start:c]
                templates.append(seq)
                template_cells.update((r, x) for x in range(start, c))
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in template_cells:
                continue
            seq = next((s for s in templates if color in s), None)
            if seq is None:
                continue
            i = seq.index(color)
            start = c - i
            for j, value in enumerate(seq):
                x = start + j
                if 0 <= x < w:
                    out[r][x] = value
    return out
'''
